{"summary": "I fixed `median()` in `src/stats.js`. It had two bugs:

- **Wrong sort order:** `.sort()` with no arguments sorts numbers as text, so `[10, 9, 1]` came out as `[1, 10, 9]` and the median was 10. It now sorts by numeric value with `(a, b) => a - b`.
- **Even-length lists:** with an even number of values it returned the upper middle value. It now returns the average of the two middle values, so `[4, 1, 3, 2]` gives `2.5`.

An empty list now returns `undefined`. I also added tests to `test/stats.test.js` for even-length lists, numbers that sort wrong as text, negative numbers and the empty list. `npm test` passes all 5 tests."}
